turns.said: Outlook on my laptop shows Disconnected and no new mail arrives. Webmail works and colleagues get mail.
turns.reply:
Since your webmail works and your colleagues are receiving emails, the issue is specific to the Outlook application on your laptop. 

Please try these steps to fix it:
1. Completely close Outlook and open it again.
2. If that does not work, recreate your Outlook mail profile via the Control Panel to let the cache rebuild.

Please let me know if this gets your emails flowing again!
